_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Glüxkind smart/AI stroller. Clek's list row says 'Glüxkind Rosa' — Rosa is Glüxkind's currently-SHIPPING smart stroller ($2,290, made in Canada) and is the model certified compatible with Clek Liing/Liingo. It is distinct from the experimental 'Ella' self-driving concept ($3,800). This fragment is built on Rosa (the Clek-listed, in-market model). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Glüxkind Rosa Smart Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Glüxkind Rosa — Universal Car Seat Adapter

specs._weightNote: Glüxkind does not publish Rosa's frame weight. It is a heavy motorized smart stroller (dual-motor, modular battery); the sibling Ella platform is cited at ~30 lb, but Rosa's exact weight is unpublished — left null rather than guessed.
specs._dimsNote: Rosa's folded/unfolded dimensions are not published by Glüxkind (a Travel Edition with flight-compliant modular battery exists). Left null — not guessed.

safety.standards: Sold into the US market; meets applicable US stroller standard (ASTM F833) though Glüxkind does not cite the standard number publicly
safety.notes: 500W duo-motor push assist; automatic/intelligent braking + automatic parking; Rock-My-Baby auto-rocking; built-in white noise; Companion App connected care. Handle presence keeps motor assist safe. Made in Canada.

specs.foldType: folding smart-stroller frame (Travel Edition offers flight-compliant modular battery)
specs.tires: motorized rear drive wheels (500W dual-motor) with front swivel; tire material not published

notes: IMPORTANT model note: Clek lists 'Glüxkind Rosa'. Rosa is Glüxkind's in-market smart stroller ($2,290 DTC, in stock, made in Canada) and is 'certified compatible with Clek Liing and Clek Liingo' — the correct match for this catalog. The experimental self-driving 'Ella' ($3,800, special-order) is a separate model on the same platform; do not conflate the price. Rosa attaches the Clek Liing via the Glüxkind Car Seat Adapter (adapter-gluxkind-universal, $70). Weight and folded/unfolded dimensions are not published by Glüxkind (left null). Max child weight 50 lb; bassinet-from-birth + lay-flat toddler seat; 500W dual-motor with automatic braking.
